I was at the top of the volcano at night, and I saw lights far, far away. I wonder if there are other bird families out there?|Leo}} '''Leo''' is a boy who initially lives on [[Ginger Island]]. His parents were lost at sea, and he considers the parrots who inhabit the island to be his family. Initially, he is too shy to speak to the player, until the player "makes friends" with the parrots of the island by collecting 10 [[Golden Walnut]]s. When the player reaches six hearts of friendship with Leo, he moves to the mainland of Stardew Valley, where he becomes friends with [[Linus]], [[Jas]] and [[Vincent]]. ==Schedule== ===Fewer than 6 After Leo moves to Stardew Valley, he bonds with [[Linus]] and begins attending [[Penny]]'s lessons with [[Vincent]] and [[Jas]]. He asks what the player is doing. *{{Choice|Just enjoying the waves.|0}} *{{Choice|Looking for fish.|0}} *{{Choice|Thinking about someone special.|0}} *{{Choice|Pondering the big questions.|0}} Leo then asks what the player's home is like. *{{Choice|There's a town full of people.|0}} *{{Choice|There's forests, beaches, and mountains.|0}} *{{Choice|It's like here, but colder.|0}} *{{Choice|I live on a farm.|0}} Leo thinks about your words for a bit before asking if there are any kids in Pelican Town *{{Choice|Yes.|0}} *{{Choice|What does that matter to a bird?|0}} Regardless of the answer, Leo says he's aware he's not really a bird, and he tries to avoid thinking about it because it makes him feel lonely. He tries to fit in with the parrots, but knows he truly doesn't belong anywhere.
